_about: Engineer-reviewed support decisions. reviewedLines preserve literal rules wording and name implemented primitives. Each reviewed entry records the exact evidence base SHA and hashes of the full Oracle rules record and adopted runtime/SDK JARs. A rules or runtime change invalidates the decision; unrelated card commits do not. Source review authorizes candidate implementation only, never certification or integration.

Eldrazi Displacer.summary: exile-then-return is Effects.Move(→EXILE) then Effects.Move(→BATTLEFIELD) (upstream Emiel the Blessed); Effects.Move takes a tapped flag (sdk-api.md, card-sdk-language-reference 'tapped = true'); {C} in an activation cost is ordinary mana

Forsaken Monument.summary: AdditionalManaOnSourceTap(sourceFilter, whenProducing = TappedForManaType.COLORLESS) takes any GameObjectFilter, so Permanent.youControl() replaces Ultima's Land.youControl(); colorless filter is GameObjectFilter.Any.withCardPredicate(CardPredicate.IsColorless) (tested custom Skittering Cicada)

Abstruse Archaic.summary: TargetFilter.ActivatedOrTriggeredAbilityOnStack.youControl().abilitySourceMatches(filter) takes any GameObjectFilter (Echo uses Creature; reference lists Artifact too); colorless via CardPredicate.IsColorless; mana abilities are untargetable by construction

Darksteel Monolith.summary: MayCastWithoutPayingManaCost(controllerOnly, spellFilter, oncePerTurn, fromZones) — Warped Space uses oncePerTurn + fromZones={EXILE}; here spellFilter = colorless (CardPredicate.IsColorless), fromZones = {HAND}. Paying {0} rather than the mana cost is the same alternative cost

Ancient Stone Idol.summary: Dies trigger: Triggers.self.dies() + Effects.CreateToken(power=6, toughness=12, creatureTypes={Construct}, keywords={TRAMPLE}, artifactToken=true); same shape as Thopter Mechanic with different stats/keyword

reviewedLines.line: When this creature dies, create a 6/12 colorless Construct artifact creature token with trample.

reviewedLines.line: Chapter Master — {6}: Create two 2/2 white Astartes Warrior creature tokens with vigilance.

Thunderhawk Gunship.summary: ETB: Triggers.self.enters() + Effects.CreateToken(count=2, 2/2, WHITE, {Astartes, Warrior}, {VIGILANCE}); Soul of Migration's trigger with Call the Cavalry's token

reviewedLines.line: When this Vehicle enters, create two 2/2 white Astartes Warrior creature tokens with vigilance.

Be'lakor, the Dark Master.summary: Triggers.another(GameObjectFilter.Creature.withSubtype(Demon).youControl()).enters() (Champion of the Path) + Effects.DealDamage(DynamicAmounts.triggeringPower(), target(Targets.Any), damageSource = EffectTarget.TriggeringEntity) (Warstorm Surge)

reviewedLines.line: Lord of Torment — Whenever another Demon you control enters, it deals damage equal to its power to any target.

Kill! Maim! Burn!.summary: Mode: target(Targets.Player) + Effects.DealDamage(3, t); Flame Jet uses Targets.PlayerOrPlaneswalker, Requisition Raid shows Targets.Player; choose-one-or-more modal already matched

reviewedLines.line: • Kill! Maim! Burn! deals 3 damage to target player.

Collective Effort.summary: Mode is Requisition Raid's third mode verbatim: target(Targets.Player) + Effects.ForEachInGroup(GroupFilter(GameObjectFilter.Creature.targetPlayerControls(player)), AddCounters(+1/+1, 1, IterationEntity)); Escalate and the other modes matched

reviewedLines.line: • Put a +1/+1 counter on each creature target player controls.

Mirrorpool.summary: Activated {4}{C}, {T}, sacrifice this land: Effects.CreateTokenCopyOfTarget(target(TargetFilter.CreatureYouControl)) (Self-Reflection), with the same tap+sacrifice-self land cost shape as its matched spell-copy line

reviewedLines.line: {4}{C}, {T}, Sacrifice this land: Create a token that's a copy of target creature you control.

Illuminor Szeras.summary: Mana ability: Costs.Composite(Costs.Tap, Costs.SacrificeAnother(GameObjectFilter.Creature)) (Bolg's Company) + Effects.AddMana(BLACK, DynamicAmounts.manaValueOf(EffectTarget.SacrificedAsCost(0))) (Priest of Yawgmoth). Scenario test must assert X = sacrificed creature's mana value with SacrificeAnother

reviewedLines.line: Secrets of the Soul — {T}, Sacrifice another creature: Add an amount of {B} equal to the sacrificed creature's mana value.

Tomb Fortress.summary: Costs.Composite(Mana, Tap, ExileSelf) and TimingRule.SorcerySpeed are listed in adopted sdk-api.md; use Pipeline mill(4), then gather FromZone(GRAVEYARD, You, Creature), gate after milling with Conditions.GraveyardContains(GameObjectFilter.Creature), chooseExactly(1), and move to battlefield. It does not target: select after milling, and never offer a decline when a creature is available. Broodheart Engine supplies the activation/timing shape; Ashcoat supplies post-mill graveyard collection/selection. Tests must cover a creature milled by this activation, no creatures, and instant-speed rejection.
Tomb Fortress.verifiedBy: GPT Work, pinned source and adopted SDK inspection 2026-10-30

reviewedLines.line: {2}{B}{B}{B}, {T}, Exile this land: Mill four cards, then return a creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield. Activate only as a sorcery.

Past in Flames.summary: Pipeline gathers current instant/sorcery cards from your graveyard, then Effects.ForEachInCollection applies Effects.GrantFlashback(IterationEntity, cost=null, EndOfTurn). Snapcaster/Slickshot prove the default original-mana-cost grant; SDK docs list collection iteration and explain that granted flashback is read by enumerator, cast handler and stack resolver. Test two eligible cards, creature exclusion, cards entering the graveyard later, cleanup expiry and exile after resolution.
Past in Flames.verifiedBy: GPT Work, pinned source and adopted SDK inspection 2026-10-30

reviewedLines.line: Each instant and sorcery card in your graveyard gains flashback until end of turn. The flashback cost is equal to its mana cost.

Tzaangor Shaman.summary: Sword of Wealth and Power proves combat damage to player creates CopyNextSpellCast restricted to instant/sorcery; change attached-source trigger to Triggers.self.dealsCombatDamage(Recipient.AnyPlayer). Flamehold Grappler proves explicit spellFilter support. Test no copy from noncombat damage, ignore next permanent, consume on next instant/sorcery, retarget and end-of-turn expiry.
Tzaangor Shaman.verifiedBy: GPT Work, pinned source and adopted SDK inspection 2026-10-30

reviewedLines.line: Sorcerous Elixir — Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, copy the next instant or sorcery spell you cast this turn when you cast it. You may choose new targets for the copy.

Kozilek's Return.summary: Cast trigger in Zone.GRAVEYARD, filter Creature.withSubtype(Eldrazi).manaValueAtLeast(7); optional IfYouDo(Move Self from GRAVEYARD to EXILE, ForEachInGroup(AllCreatures, DealDamage(5))). SDK documents triggerZone and IfYouDo Auto terminal-zone-move success; do not replace the cast trigger with an enters trigger or require resolution of the creature spell. Test declining exile, intervening removal from graveyard, countered creature still triggering, and threshold 6 vs 7.
Kozilek's Return.verifiedBy: GPT Work, pinned source and adopted SDK inspection 2026-10-30

reviewedLines.line: Whenever you cast an Eldrazi creature spell with mana value 7 or greater, you may exile this card from your graveyard. If you do, this card deals 5 damage to each creature.

Purestrain Genestealer.summary: Attack trigger optionally IfYouDo(RemoveCounters(+1/+1,1,Self), Patterns.Library.searchLibrary(BasicLand, BATTLEFIELD, entersTapped=true), successCriterion=CountersRemoved). SDK explicitly documents CountersRemoved and no payoff if source left or has no counter. Primeval Herald/Worldwagon prove search and shuffle. Test decline, zero counters, source removed before resolution, tapped land and shuffle.
Purestrain Genestealer.verifiedBy: GPT Work, pinned source and adopted SDK inspection 2026-10-30

reviewedLines.line: Vanguard Species — Whenever this creature attacks, you may remove a +1/+1 counter from it. If you do, search your library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.

Exocrine.summary: Spiteful Banditry proves ETB DynamicAmounts.xValue damage; apply ForEachPlayer(Each, DealDamage(x)) and ForEachInGroup(Creature, excludeSelf=true, DealDamage(x)). Pestilence proves the combined creature/player iteration shape; SDK lists both iteration forms; preserve X chosen on cast, not current counters/power. Existing Ravenous primitive covers its matched keyword. Test X=0, multiple players, source excluded, other creatures included and Ravenous threshold.
Exocrine.verifiedBy: GPT Work, pinned source and adopted SDK inspection 2026-10-30

reviewedLines.line: Bio-plasmic Barrage — When this creature enters, it deals X damage to each player and each other creature.

Test newly drawn eligible card, MV6 rejection, decline, land exclusion and additional-cost/target handling through normal cast path.
